fields.description:
Objective

Auto-calculate the referral payout on a Sign-Up from the signup market and referral currency.

Implementation Requirements

* Populate Payout Amount automatically when Referrer is populated AND Referral Type is Cash or Bet

* Recalculate whenever Referral Type changes

* Core rules:

* Payout currency = Referral Currency

* Payout amount determined by Signup Currency (market-based)

* Payout matrix:

* CAD signup + CAD referral -> 25 CAD cash / 40 CAD bet credit

* CAD signup + USD referral -> 20 USD cash / 30 USD bet credit

* USD signup + CAD referral -> 50 CAD cash / 80 CAD bet credit

* USD signup + USD referral -> 30 USD cash / 50 USD bet credit

* USD amounts for CAD signups are FIXED (20 / 30) — no FX calculation anywhere

Acceptance Criteria

* All four matrix combinations produce the correct amount and currency

* Changing Referral Type recalculates

* No FX conversion is performed anywhere in this logic

Dependencies

BUILD-15 (field — complete).

Open Questions

* Should the matrix live in Custom Metadata so Ops can change rates without a deployment? STRONGLY RECOMMENDED over hardcoding in a formula or flow — these rates will change.

Estimate: M · \~8h

Source: Wagertech Additional User Stories, July 2026 — item 8.
